# B2_STATIC/v1 — NATIVE TYPESCRIPT T0 DEPENDENCY BASELINE — META-380

**Issue:** Linear META-380 · **Preregistration:** `5ccb7ff6dd7a59a276aa3d6aa372f3df3bf1505d` (binding) · **Pre-outcome freeze:** `04557b2e3f33636e53fbfc5d7bd857315960083f`

`B2_STATIC/v1` resolves TypeScript import declarations through the native
TypeScript compiler API against each query's own T0 tree, then ranks candidates
lexicographically by: dependency path exists DESC, shortest BFS distance ASC
(depth ≤ 4), same package DESC, frozen `B1` structural score DESC, lexical path ASC.

**Zero history. Zero transaction-`T` outcome information.** Invariant I-B2
(PASS) confirms the ranking function's only inputs are the T0 tree,
its resolved edges, the extant test set and `S(T)`. Invariant I-B2R
(PASS) confirms a full, non-incremental rebuild of the graph at T0
reproduces the frozen ranking byte-for-byte on 20 strided probes.
Red test RT9 confirms the graph is sensitive to leakage: injecting history- and
outcome-derived edges changes the B2 top-10.

Per-repository validity under §22 is in `B2-VALIDITY.md`.
